settings.headline: Trust starts with clear boundaries.
settings.intro: TraceKit's product direction emphasizes governed access, tenant context, auditable operations, and traceable evidence. Security questions deserve specific answers.
settings.note: Do not interpret this page as a claim of SOC 2, ISO certification, or any unverified third-party audit.

settings.heading: Role-aware access
settings.body: Account membership and role boundaries determine which information and tools are available.

settings.heading: Governed operations
settings.body: Sensitive actions should respect authorization, policy, and audit requirements.

settings.heading: Source traceability
settings.body: Maintain source evidence and distinguish verified links from unresolved records.

settings.heading: Security review
settings.body: Request current documentation about deployment, data handling, controls, and available assurances.
